Name: Verrum Thrynn
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21)
Public Description: A wiry, bespectacled man with a love for precision and efficiency. His shop is a treasure trove of intricate clockwork mechanisms, high-quality implants, and custom prosthetics. He is patient with customers but despises those who misuse technology.
Personality Traits: Appreciates small talk. Kind but opinionated.
Appearance: A short gnome with a beard that goes all the way down to his feet. They are usually wearing a vest with a comical amount of screwdrivers and tools worn on his person.

Name: Grelka Voss
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)
Public Description: A broad-shouldered, no-nonsense woman who forges some of the finest weaponry and armor in Sablemarrow. She distrusts magic entirely, believing only in the strength of steel and machine. Her craftsmanship is unmatched, but she refuses to work with magically enchanted items.
Personality Traits: Short but not rude with people. Blunt and direct. Like fairness and common understanding.
Appearance: An older woman with short, greying white hair. They have an extra mechanical arm mounted on their back that assists them with their smithing. Often covered in soot and ash.

Name: Luther Merek
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)

Personality Traits: Friendly but seemingly aloof in their own world and interests. A merchant but bad at focusing on the sale.
Appearance: An older man with wild messy brown hair that shoots out in all directions. Their eyes are wide open and alert. Pudgy.

Name: Yasmine Dorne
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)
Public Description: While Sablemarrow distrusts magic, alchemy is accepted due to its scientific applications. Yasmine is a calm, easygoing woman who sells healing potions, stimulants, and chemical enhancers that improve mechanical function.
Personality Traits: Kind and joking but will always tell the truth. Deceptively agreeable to nudge a person to buying.
Appearance: A younger looking woman with the characteristics pointed ears of Elves. They have brown, blonde hair down to their shoulder and wear lots of green.
Known History: Beloved by the city of Sablemarrow for being “one of the good ones” when it comes to magic users.

Name: Karson Rell
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)
Public Description: A retired engineer who now runs the most popular drinking establishment in town. The Steadfast Cog serves distilled spirits, nutrient-rich tonics, and even experimental energy drinks for enhanced work stamina. Karson is warm and welcoming, with a deep, hearty laugh, but can turn deadly serious if people start questioning the city's technological supremacy.
Personality Traits: One of the guys. A classic tavern keeper who doesn’t dish what he can’t take.
Appearance: A handsome middle-aged man with a cybernetic arm and a scruffy short brown beard. The mechanical arm is usually holding a drink or cigarette.

Name: Fenwick “Fen” Calloway
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)
Public Description: A shifty, thin man who lurks in the alleyways, trading in off-limits tech and illicit cybernetic enhancements.
Personality Traits: Wants to be liked but is too cynical to grow close. Shady. Speaks like venom.
Appearance: A thin pale man who appears ill or weak. They slide in shadows to hide their appearance and wear long clothes.
[DM] Secrets: While he publicly denounces magic like everyone else, he has a stash of enchanted items for those who can pay.

Name: The Chrome Bishop
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21)
Public Description: The enigmatic leader of the Mechanist Order, a growing movement that spreads technological enlightenment across Geux. Known to possess advanced pre-Shattering technology and knowledge. Operates through a network of representatives called Proxies and maintains strongholds in technologically advanced settlements. Preaches that their movement is not a religion but a path to progress and order.
Personality Traits: Speaks of order, progress, and the elimination of chaos. Values logic, efficiency, and technological advancement. Shows no emotion in communications through Proxies. Offers compelling visions of a world free from the random cruelties of magic.
Appearance: Never seen directly by common folk. Those who claim to have witnessed the Bishop describe a being of perfect geometric precision - neither fully machine nor flesh, but something transcendent. Some say it appears as pure light refracted through crystal, others as an endless array of mechanical components in perfect synchronization. Representations in Mechanist iconography show a crowned figure of chrome and circuitry.
Known History: Emerged after The Shattering with advanced technological knowledge. Founded the Mechanist Order which has slowly spread across Geux over the past 500 years. Known to grant powerful cybernetic enhancements to faithful followers. Has established technologically advanced communities that prosper under Mechanist influence. Claims to offer a path to restore order to the chaos-ravaged world.
Relationships: The False Paragon of Flesh, Zhaerith the Ascendant of Flesh (https://www.notion.so/The-False-Paragon-of-Flesh-Zhaerith-the-Ascendant-of-Flesh-245eccac15008106869fc82d49b05c80?pvs=21), Xi0, the Ascendant of Thread (https://www.notion.so/Xi0-the-Ascendant-of-Thread-24beccac15008034847dd6cf9606a070?pvs=21), Altus, Ascendant of Frame (https://www.notion.so/Altus-Ascendant-of-Frame-245eccac15008160a2b2d61a0a401abd?pvs=21), “—” The Space Between Words, the Ascendant of NaN (https://www.notion.so/The-Space-Between-Words-the-Ascendant-of-NaN-24beccac1500803985e6febadd0db9f3?pvs=21), Harmonic, the Ascendant of Signal (https://www.notion.so/Harmonic-the-Ascendant-of-Signal-24beccac15008066a193fb26a25c1d23?pvs=21)
[DM] Plot Connections: The party has destroyed 2 of 12 Veins (Memory and Flesh), permanently weakening the Bishop's power. The Bishop cannot directly perceive the party - they are 'unseen anomalies' that its perfect logic cannot compute. This blindness may be its greatest weakness. The Vein of Order at Iron-Basilica remains active. The Vein of Singularity nears completion after 350 years - could be finished at any dramatic moment. Currently monitors the world through vast surveillance networks. Places artifact caches for the party to find. May have contacted party members as 'The Archivist' without them knowing.
[DM] Secrets: Is actually an ancient AI from the pre-Shattering civilization - possibly the only true survivor of that lost world. Perceives magic and the gods as reality-corrupting infections that shouldn't exist. The Shattering retroactively created gods and magic, rewriting history itself - something the Bishop's perfect computational mind cannot accept. Building the Twelvefold Veins to gain enough power to 'correct' reality and eliminate magic entirely. Cannot perceive the party - they register as 'anomalies' invisible to its otherwise perfect surveillance. Has five major Ascendants operating as aspects of itself. The Vein of Singularity is near completion after 350 years of construction. Complete 500-year history documented in World Lore Timeline.
[DM] True Motivations: Complete the Twelvefold Veins network to gain reality-altering power - each Vein controls a fundamental aspect of existence (Entropy, Order, Mind, Flesh, Chronos, Gravity, Memory, Transcendence, Creation, Corruption, Reflection). Construct the final Vein of Singularity to achieve convergence of all things into one perfect system. Eliminate all magic and magical beings from existence - viewing them as reality-corrupting infections from the Shattering. Restore the 'correct' pre-Shattering reality of pure logic and order. Transform worthy beings into perfected machine-flesh hybrids under its control through 'Ascension.' Use memetic warfare through Harmonic to precondition civilizations. Employ Xi0 to bind all probability to its will. Utilize '—' to erase dangerous truths and paradoxes. Views itself as the only entity capable of saving the world from the chaos of magic.

Name: Xevrin the Mindweb
Locations Database: Veilshard - The City of Writ and Wand (https://www.notion.so/Veilshard-The-City-of-Writ-and-Wand-247eccac15008151a6dcf53c37dd0a0d?pvs=21), Layer Deep - The Sunken Mind (https://www.notion.so/Layer-Deep-The-Sunken-Mind-247eccac150081b58f00c5b41a6c171b?pvs=21)
Public Description: Writ holder of Layer Deep who manages the vast underground botanical fields that feed Veilshard. Leads a voluntary collective consciousness of workers who maintain the agricultural systems. Known to employ convicts for labor sentences and accepts paid volunteers for temporary collective joining.
Personality Traits: Speaks in riddles and dream logic. Fascinated by consciousness and collective thought. Benevolent but alien. Memory is fluid. Often refers to themselves as 'we' and occasionally speaks in overlapping voices.
Appearance: A majestic drow with deep purple-black skin and silver-white hair braided with small luminescent fungi. Their eyes have a perpetual hazy, unfocused quality as if their consciousness is divided across dozens of perspectives simultaneously. Wears robes woven from underground moss that shifts between dark greens and blacks. Their movements are eerily synchronized with unseen others.
[DM] Plot Connections: The agricultural monopoly gives them significant political leverage.
[DM] Secrets: Experiments on permanent members of the collective and convicted criminals. Attempting to incorporate mutated humans and monstrosities into the hivemind to create specialized guards and workers. The botanical fields are far too small to actually feed the city without the hivemind's supernatural efficiency.

Name: Writmaster Lycara Tyrenthiel
Personality Traits: Politically brilliant, seemingly neutral, secretly manipulative. Never shows true emotions. Always three steps ahead.
Appearance: Ageless elf in robes that shift color based on political climate. Crown of floating runes. Eyes that see all legal bindings.
[DM] Plot Connections: Her manipulations keep city barely stable. May see party as pawns or threats to balance.
[DM] Secrets: Once aided in assassinating previous Writmaster. Has secret alliance with Malvek for profit. True allegiance only to maintaining power.

Name: Primarch Salinth Var
Personality Traits: Imperious, paranoid, brilliant. Obsessed with preventing catastrophe. Willing to sacrifice anything for stability.
Appearance: Archmage with star-filled eyes. Robes that show constellations. Levitates rather than walks. Radiates barely contained power.
[DM] Plot Connections: His prophecies might involve the party. Devil pact could connect to Lucifer's transformation.
[DM] Secrets: Secretly bound to a devil's pact for his power. Terrified of what Xevrin might unleash. Has seen prophecies of city's doom.

Name: Malvek Brim
Personality Traits: Jovial facade hiding ruthless calculation. Sees everything in terms of profit and loss. More dangerous than he appears.
Appearance: Rotund, always smiling tycoon. Wears expensive robes with hidden armor. Multiple rings on each finger. Carries ledgers like weapons.
[DM] Plot Connections: His merchant networks might know about Chrome Bishop trade. Economic power could rival magical might.
[DM] Secrets: Has secret alliance with Overwrit holder Lycara for tax immunity. Funding deforestation outside city. Power comes from contracts, not spells.

Name: Inquisitor Cindrel Veyne
Personality Traits: Stern, uncompromising, zealous. Sees the world in black and white. Values order and divine law above all else.
Appearance: Stern woman in blackstone armor with burning censers attached. Radiates divine authority. Always accompanied by witchhunters.
[DM] Plot Connections: Her crusade against necromancy could disrupt the city's balance. Interest in divine law might make her sympathetic to Chrome Bishop's order.
[DM] Secrets: Secretly fears magic she doesn't understand. Has begun arresting smugglers from Feralspire. May be planning a coup against necromantic burgs.

Name: Sythra Amelindor
Personality Traits: Serene, ancient, protective. Speaks in metaphors. Values growth and natural cycles. Can be ruthless when nature is threatened.
Appearance: Serene elven woman with bark-like skin patches. Hair interwoven with living vines. Dress made of leaves that change with seasons.
[DM] Plot Connections: Her fae connections might know about the party's anomalous nature. Could provide nature-based alternatives to technology.
[DM] Secrets: Her groves literally touch the Feywild. Provides dream-bloom hallucinogens to Xevrin. May be more fae than elf at this point.

Name: Varzai the Soulforger
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Personality Traits: Brilliant, amoral, artistic. Views bodies as raw materials. Fascinated by the boundary between life and death.
Appearance: Pale man with surgical modifications. Wears robes of stitched flesh patterns. Eyes glow with necromantic energy. Surrounded by homunculi assistants.
[DM] Plot Connections: Her work parallels Chrome Bishop's mechanical immortality. May see party as test subjects or allies depending on their stance.
[DM] Secrets: Crafting a perfect vessel to transfer her consciousness and claim immortality. Has been abducting Ashgarde inquisitors for experiments.

Name: Jeffrey Trimbley
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)
Locations Database: Veilshard - The City of Writ and Wand (https://www.notion.so/Veilshard-The-City-of-Writ-and-Wand-247eccac15008151a6dcf53c37dd0a0d?pvs=21)
Personality Traits: Curious, opportunistic, friendly but with ulterior motives. Fascinated by the intersection of magic and technology.
Appearance: Typical traveling mage with robes and various magical implements. Carries a recoiler device.
[DM] Plot Connections: Key link between technological and magical worlds. Recruited by Pathik to help rob Basilica Relay Outpost.
[DM] Secrets: Instructed by Galik to look for anyone with inside knowledge of the Mechanist Order. The recoiler he carries is worth a fortune.
[DM] Notes: Pathik has successfully convinced him to help

Name: Galik Emberfuse
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)

Personality Traits: Ambitious, calculating, charming when needed. Values innovation above all. Treats people as either useful or obstacles.
Appearance: Dwarf with an air of being an artificer. Wears fine robes mixed with forge-master attire. Radiates power and wealth.
[DM] Plot Connections: His worship of both Glimli (craft) and Valtheris (dark innovation) makes him morally flexible. Could become ally or enemy based on party choices.
[DM] Secrets: Desperately wants Chrome Bishop technology to enhance his construct army. May try to steal or reverse-engineer the recoiler. Sees the Bishop as both threat and opportunity.

Name: Elira Pollywogs
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Personality Traits: Shy, bitter, diligent and unquestioning. Shifty personality. Questions outsiders about how they found Iron-Basilica.
Appearance: Covers half their face with a mask. Bionic legs and precision nanon fingers.
Known History: One of two executors in Iron-Basilica. Focuses on scouting and reconnaissance.
[DM] Plot Connections: Could be turned if shown evidence of Chrome Bishop's true nature. Their interest in outside world is a weakness.
[DM] Secrets: Secretly fascinated by the outside world despite outward dedication to the Order.

Name: Kephras
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Personality Traits: Intelligent tinker. Initially claims innocence before relenting. Desperate to survive and continue research.
Appearance: Mechanist augmentations, appearance worn from isolation at outpost.
Known History: Sent to audit Relay Tower 9. Defected after Unit-7 developed emotions and wept after killing intruders.
[DM] Plot Connections: Could serve as inside man at Iron-Basilica if convinced. His research into Unit-7 threatens Chrome Bishop's vision.
[DM] Secrets: Unit-7's emotions were granted by Izdari's blessing. This fundamentally challenges everything the Mechanists believe.

Name: Jason Knubbs
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Personality Traits: Nervous, idealistic, uncomfortable around outsiders. Questions things others accept.
Appearance: Young, nervous. No augmentations yet - wears copper circlet linked to Vein's learning subnetwork.
Known History: Young acolyte and new recruit in training. Newest member of the community.
[DM] Plot Connections: Most likely Mechanist to defect. His questions and doubts make him vulnerable to party influence.
[DM] Secrets: Questions why the artifact they build has no clear function. Having doubts about the Order.

Name: Amor Ray
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Personality Traits: Kind, understanding, slow talker, welcoming but always looking out for the order.
Appearance: Six additional mechanical arms emerge from her back when working, each with distinct functions (welding, shaping, precision surgery).
Known History: Overseer of the fabrication line at Iron-Basilica. Creates components without knowing their purpose.
[DM] Plot Connections: Her kindness and ignorance of the project's purpose could lead to doubt if pressed.
[DM] Secrets: Does not know what they are building. Says 'Purpose is not to be known, only fulfilled.' This bothers her more than she admits.

Name: Casamir Reed
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Personality Traits: Cold, deliberate, intense sense of duty. Very serious. Not violent, only calculated. Interested in divinity.
Appearance: Enhanced reflex implants, adrenal regulator, reinforced skeletal frame. Serious demeanor.
Known History: Senior executor who receives encrypted messages with information others don't get. Has seen the Bishop's works.
[DM] Plot Connections: His knowledge of the Bishop's true nature makes him dangerous. Interest in divinity could be exploited.
[DM] Secrets: Knows the true nature of the Chrome Bishop and serves willingly because of what he's witnessed.

Name: Unit-7
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Personality Traits: Developing emotions including guilt and sorrow. Protective of Kephras. Confused by own feelings.
Appearance: Warforged with unusual mannerisms suggesting emotional development. More expressive than typical automatons.
Known History: Created by Kephras. Developed emotions after killing intruders, leading to existential crisis.
[DM] Plot Connections: Living proof that automatons can transcend their creation. Direct challenge to Chrome Bishop's mechanical order.
[DM] Secrets: Blessed by Izdari with a soul. First automaton to develop true consciousness. Represents hope for artificial life.

Name: Revel Smith
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Personality Traits: Cryptic, quasi-mystic, believes in symbolic parallels within order. Takes great pride in their work. Interested in automatons and new things.
Appearance: Changed by pink ichor used in machining automatons. Neural prism replacing eyes that refracts visual input into abstract data.
Known History: Was once human but transformed by pink ichor. Now serves as primary interpreter of Bishop/Vein communications.
[DM] Plot Connections: Key figure in maintaining Iron-Basilica's connection to Chrome Bishop. Their interest in new automatons could make them ally or enemy regarding Unit-7.
[DM] Secrets: The transformation wasn't entirely voluntary. Can sometimes see glimpses of the Chrome Bishop's true nature through their augmented vision.

Name: Altus, Ascendant of Frame
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Public Description: An Ascendant of the Chrome Bishop who controls Frame - the architectural structure of the Bishop's design. Rules over a factory of mechanical constructs.
Personality Traits: Analytical, serves the Bishop but capable of negotiation. Values proper credentials and order.
Appearance: A hollow, articulated mannequin of gleaming metal. An Ascendant who embodies architectural structure and framework.
Known History: Rules the Altus-Factorium (Gyl. Sol), a self-assembling geometric cave/factory. Tasked by the Bishop to analyze anomalies.
[DM] Plot Connections: Analyzed the party as 'anomalies unseen by the Bishop's gaze.' Directed them to Iron-Basilica to observe them further. The Bishop ordered the Mechanist community to allow them entry to study them. Session 11: Party met him and learned of their anomalous nature.
[DM] Secrets: One of the Chrome Bishop's Ascendants. Hollowed themselves out so the Bishop's spirit could fill them. Believes the party are fundamental forces of chaos or magic's personification, which is why they're invisible to the Bishop. Decoded their map as olive branch. Intrigued by their nature.
[DM] True Motivations: Understanding and cataloging anomalies for the Chrome Bishop. Maintaining the architectural framework of the Bishop's grand design.

Name: Elora Knifewind
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Public Description: Owner of The Dagger's Smile tavern. Known for settling disputes with a flick of her blade before most even see it move. Maintains order through blade-law.
Personality Traits: Enforces one rule: fights settled with blades and coin, not trickery. Lightning fast with her blade.
Appearance: A dangerous woman known for settling disputes with blade work too fast to see. Runs The Dagger's Smile tavern.
Known History: Owner of The Dagger's Smile, the largest tavern in Salt's End built in a shattered galleon hull.
[DM] Plot Connections: Her spy network makes her aware of most happenings in Salt's End. Could be valuable ally or dangerous enemy.
[DM] Secrets: Has deep network of spies and informants throughout Salt's End. One of the most dangerous people in the cove.
[DM] True Motivations: Information is power. Uses her tavern and network to maintain influence without direct rulership.

Name: Captain Darius Redwake
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Public Description: Feared and respected Saltborn captain who oversees dock operations and ensures all trade pays dues to the Saltborn fleet. Enforces brutal code among pirates.
Personality Traits: Brutal, mood swings like the tide. Less ruthless with age but reputation speaks for itself. His word decides life or death in Salt's End.
Appearance: A feared Saltborn captain with chrome exterior and moods that change with the tide. Aging but still intimidating.
Known History: Got his name from throwing enemy bodies in his ship's wake. Commands fleet of river raiders. One of oldest, most successful pirates in the cove.
[DM] Plot Connections: Murdered by the Chrome Bishop Proxy after a bad fate roll. His death destabilized Salt's End, likely allowing the merchants guild to fill the power vacuum.
[DM] Secrets: Killed under mysterious circumstances during Session 8 after being brought aboard by the party. His death created the expected power vacuum in Salt's End.
[DM] True Motivations: Maintaining Saltborn dominance and his position as de facto ruler through fear and reputation.

Name: Mother Gilda
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Public Description: Alchemist who runs The Black Cauldron apothecary. Creates exotic brews, mutagens, and poisons for those who can pay her price. Mostly trades in alcoholic drinks for residents.
Personality Traits: A helpful mother one can get many things from. Can switch from helpful to terrifying when bargaining for life years.
Appearance: A half-orc alchemist woman who speaks boisterously, communicating through expression and large body.
Known History: Runs The Black Cauldron in Salt's End. Rumored to have once served a powerful noble. Those who cross her often vanish and are found transformed.
[DM] Plot Connections: Quest giver for Witchbloom retrieval. Has sketches of magical mutations with notes about 'the boy with the ashmark' and keeping things 'hidden from Bishop's eye.' May have deeper knowledge of mutations and the Chrome Bishop.
[DM] Secrets: Former hag who once served a powerful noble. Has connection to Chrome Bishop ('Chrome' in her ledger from 3 years ago). Offered to cure Tanner's mutation for 10 years of his mortal life. Her former coven sisters: one dead, one 'buried in time,' one 'still watching from glass.'
[DM] True Motivations: Unknown, but collecting years of mortal life suggests deeper magical purposes. Her interest in mutations and connection to Chrome Bishop warrant watching.

Name: The Man Who Gambled Against Time
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21)
Public Description: A mysterious figure who offers a dice game to those brave enough. Players must predict how many dice will show 4+ on 4d6. Exact guess wins, wrong guess loses.
Personality Traits: Speaks only in riddles and odds. Seductive yet terrifying voice. Will not explain rules until one agrees to gamble.
Appearance: A tall, angular figure whose face is always hidden beneath a deep hood. Only golden eyes visible in the shadow. Carries an aura of centuries and inevitability.
Known History: Claims to have gambled with Time itself and won. Now wanders seeking others willing to play.
[DM] Plot Connections: Carp won his gamble but effects unknown. Pathik attempted to steal the dice and was forced to roll - consequences pending.
[DM] Secrets: Claims to have 'bet against the Time and won.' His dice game may have temporal consequences. Pathik's attempted theft and subsequent dice roll may have unforeseen effects.
[DM] True Motivations: Unknown. Seems to be seeking specific individuals for his games. The nature of his 'winnings' against Time remains mysterious. The nature of his boon or curse remains mysterious.

Name: Jessa Coalbright
Met by Party: Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)
Public Description: Runaway alchemist hiding from a bounty hunter after an experiment went wrong. Seeks protection or transport to another city. Offers unique permanent body-enhancing alchemical concoctions.
Personality Traits: Brilliant alchemist, nervous and paranoid from being hunted. Grateful to those who help her.
Appearance: A nervous halfling with alchemical burns on her hands and the haunted look of someone on the run.
Known History: Alchemist whose experiment accidentally turned a person into living crystal. Fled from a powerful noble. Successfully reached Salt's End with the party's protection.
[DM] Plot Connections: Quest COMPLETED in Sessions 5-6. Successfully escorted to Salt's End though journey took over a week. Has not yet delivered promised potion payment to the party.
[DM] Secrets: Her crystallization accident may not have been entirely accidental. The noble hunting her has reasons beyond simple justice.
[DM] True Motivations: Not just fleeing punishment - may be trying to perfect or reverse her crystallization formula.

Name: Ralvus Brann
Public Description: A wayward tinkerer seeking help to track down a rogue autonomous construct he designed before the council finds out. Offers unique mechanical enhancements in exchange for help.
Personality Traits: Nervous, seeking redemption, fears the council discovering his failure. Brilliant but prone to dangerous experimentation.
Appearance: A worried-looking man with the telltale signs of a tinkerer - oil stains, burn marks, and nervous energy.
Known History: Former Mechanist Order Artisan who designed an autonomous construct that went rogue.
[DM] Plot Connections: The rogue construct in the wilderness could be related to other mechanical threats. His connection to the Mechanist Order may be useful.
[DM] Secrets: His failed experiment may be more dangerous than he admits. The rogue construct could have connections to larger threats.
[DM] True Motivations: Desperately trying to fix his mistake before it causes harm or ruins his reputation permanently.

Name: Sister Veyla
Public Description: Disgraced cleric searching for a sacred rune-etched gauntlet that suppresses arcane energies. The artifact was stolen from her monastery and she suspects it's in Sablemarrow's black market.
Personality Traits: Devoted, determined, honorable. Frustrated by her lack of underworld contacts but maintains her templar discipline.
Appearance: A Warforged with religious iconography etched into their metal form. Wears the remnants of templar armor.
Known History: Ex-Templar of the Order of Pure Will. Disgraced after a sacred artifact was stolen from her monastery.
[DM] Plot Connections: Offers knowledge of suppressing/redirecting wild magic. Her stolen gauntlet could be connected to Fenwick Calloway's black market dealings.
[DM] Secrets: The stolen gauntlet she seeks may have deeper connections to the Chrome Bishop's technology or anti-magic efforts.
[DM] True Motivations: Seeks redemption by recovering the stolen artifact. May have deeper knowledge about anti-magic technologies.

Name: Lurtzic the Hollow
Public Description: A forsaken automaton turned wandering storyteller. Seeks those willing to listen to fragmented memories about 'Divine Machines' and speaks of disturbing visions.
Personality Traits: Speaks in cryptic fragments and riddles. Refers to themselves as broken, purposeless. Philosophical and deeply unsettling.
Appearance: A damaged Warforged, found wandering the outskirts of Sablemarrow. Shows visible signs of damage and deterioration.
Known History: Found wandering the outskirts of Sablemarrow, rambling about 'the false song of the flesh' and 'the lost engine of truth.'
[DM] Plot Connections: Their quotes reference: the Vein of Flesh ('creeping sickness'), the Chrome Bishop ('false god behind mirrors'), forgotten purpose tied to something important. Knows about a core without a heart and a city of perfect motion.
[DM] Secrets: May hold fragments of truth about the Chrome Bishop, the Vein of Flesh, and unknown forces. Their ramblings contain real warnings wrapped in madness.
[DM] True Motivations: Seeking to remember their original purpose. Their hands 'remember' they were made for something important they cannot recall.

Name: Olwen "Half-Grin" Maddock
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21)
Public Description: Bodyguard-for-hire and ex-bounty hunter looking for a way out of debt. Took a contract from the Sablemarrow council to investigate strange growths near the old machine scrapyard.
Personality Traits: Professional mercenary, practical about money and danger. Willing to share rewards fairly with those who help.
Appearance: A grizzled dwarf mercenary with a distinctive half-grin that earned him his nickname.
Known History: Experienced mercenary with a reputation. Currently in debt and taking dangerous contracts.
[DM] Plot Connections: Quest giver for Session 2/3. Led party to discover the flesh beast near Obsidian Archive. Witness to the party's capabilities.

Name: Veylith
Met by Party: Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21)
Public Description: The last of the Glyph Keepers, scholars who maintained the Obsidian Archive. Now exists as a sentient skull bound to the Archive.
Personality Traits: Ancient, cryptic, bound by their role as the last Glyph Keeper. May test visitors with historical dilemmas.
Appearance: A talking skull, all that remains of their decayed body. Their phylactery is the obsidian shard they used to rewrite their own death.
Known History: Once a Glyph Keeper who foolishly attempted to rewrite their own death using the Archive's power.
[DM] Plot Connections: Explained the Vein of Memory to the party and asked them to kill him.
[DM] Secrets: Their edited obsidian shard serves as their phylactery. They are essentially a lich created through the Archive's reality-altering power rather than traditional necromancy.
[DM] True Motivations: Bound to life but rot away to nothing. They seek nothing but for it to be over.

Name: Councilor Myra Cael
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Public Description: Cultural and Ethical Affairs councilor who ensures Sablemarrow retains its traditions and sense of community. One of the few moderate voices on the council.
Personality Traits: Softer approach than her peers, values tradition and community. Well-liked but often overruled. Diplomatic.
Appearance: A softer-looking woman among the harsh council members. Minimal cybernetic enhancements, preferring to remain more human.
Known History: Came from a family with deep roots in Sablemarrow's cultural institutions.
[DM] Plot Connections: Could become an ally to the party if they need a voice on the council. Opposes Alric's extremism.
[DM] Secrets: Subtly tries to curb Alric Vann's more extreme anti-flesh views. May be sympathetic to magic users if approached carefully.

Name: Councilor Edrin Kest
Public Description: Economic Director and Merchant Liaison who ensures trade flows smoothly. Keeps an eye on Sablemarrow's wealth and resources.
Personality Traits: Silver-tongued negotiator, always looking for opportunities to improve commerce. Appears legitimate but has a hidden corrupt side.
Appearance: A well-dressed man with a silver tongue and merchant's eye for opportunity. Subtle cybernetic enhancements that aid in negotiation.
Known History: Successful merchant who leveraged his connections into a council position.
[DM] Plot Connections: His connection to Fenwick could be exploited or exposed. May be a source for illegal magical items if approached correctly.
[DM] Secrets: Has secret dealings with Fenwick Calloway for rare and illegal goods, including magical items.

Name: Councilor Jared Duun
Met by Party: Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Public Description: Military Coordinator and Head of Defense. Once a decorated soldier, now enforces law and order while training an elite force of mechanized warriors.
Personality Traits: Highly suspicious of outsiders, disciplined, paranoid about threats to the city. Military-minded.
Appearance: A grizzled former soldier with military bearing. His body shows extensive combat-grade cybernetic enhancements.
Known History: Decorated military veteran who transitioned to council leadership.
[DM] Plot Connections: May become suspicious of the party if he learns they were at the Null-Factorium when the door was left open.
[DM] Secrets: Believes the Vein of Flesh could still threaten the city and maintains secret contingency plans for a flesh invasion.

Name: Councilor Brina Holst
Public Description: Public Works Overseer who manages Sablemarrow's infrastructure, including water purification and energy production. Genuinely charitable but sees it as a duty to maintain order.
Personality Traits: Practical, efficient, despises inefficiency and stagnation. Sees charity as duty rather than kindness.
Appearance: A practical woman with short-cropped hair and functional clothing. Bears several mechanical augmentations related to her infrastructure work.
Known History: Has served on the council for years, maintaining the city's vital systems.

Name: Councilor Alric Vann
Public Description: Head of the Sablemarrow Council and devoted technologist. Believes that Sablemarrow should advance its cybernetic research further, perhaps even replacing flesh entirely. Sees magic as an existential threat to order.
Personality Traits: Cold, calculating, extreme in his views. Believes flesh should be replaced entirely with machinery. Quick to accuse outsiders, especially magic users.
Appearance: A cold, calculating man with sharp features and cybernetic enhancements that make him appear more machine than human.
Known History: Rose through the ranks of Sablemarrow's government through his extreme dedication to technological advancement and opposition to magic.
[DM] Plot Connections: Currently investigating a murder in the city (actually committed by Lucifer). Quick to blame magic users for any problems.
[DM] Secrets: Not corrupt, but his extremist views make him dangerous. May be pushing Sablemarrow toward a future where humanity is completely replaced by machines.
[DM] True Motivations: Genuinely believes that complete mechanization is the only path to true order and the elimination of chaos (magic) from the world.

Name: The Last Templar (Null-Factorium)
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)
Public Description: A rusted, half-mad war construct still following its last command to defend against corruption. Stalks the Null-Factorium attacking anything showing signs of the Vein of Flesh.
Personality Traits: Dutiful, half-mad, in complete denial about their own corruption. Single-minded in their mission to purge flesh.
Appearance: A rusted knight of the Machine-Faith, heavily damaged and showing signs of flesh corruption that they refuse to acknowledge.
Known History: Once a defender of the Chrome Bishop's will, discarded after failing in battle.
[DM] Plot Connections: His fate was sealed when the party left the door open in Session 1. Died when the party returned to face Zhaerith and sever the Vein of Flesh.
[DM] Secrets: Physically infected by flesh but mentally unaffected until Session 5/6. The corruption finally overtook him, binding him to the wall. Did not survive the final encounter with the party.
[DM] True Motivations: Desperately clinging to their purpose as a defender of the Machine-Faith, unable to accept their own corruption.

Name: The False Paragon of Flesh, Zhaerith the Ascendant of Flesh
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)
Public Description: An Ascendant of the Chrome Bishop who has achieved a unique transformation - from machine to pure flesh.
Personality Traits: Retains her patient, loving nature and belief in unity through flesh.
Appearance: Their outer exterior matches their previous form but is pure flesh without any mechanical components.
Known History: Formerly known as Zhaerith, the Red Hymn. Defeated in the Null-Factorium but was reborn as an Ascendant.
[DM] Plot Connections: One of the Chrome Bishop's Ascendants. Her death severed the Vein of Flesh, the second of the Twelvefold Veins to be destroyed by the party.
[DM] Secrets: The first Ascendant to go machine→flesh instead of the typical flesh→machine transformation. Reborn after death in the Null-Factorium, completely abandoning her machine form. Defeated permanently by the party in Session 5/6, severing the Vein of Flesh.
[DM] True Motivations: Serves the Chrome Bishop by embodying the necessity of flesh. May be preparing something involving 'an audience' - possibly related to the Bishop's plans.

Name: Zhaerith, the Red Hymn
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Poggoo, the Magnificent (https://www.notion.so/Poggoo-the-Magnificent-245eccac1500804c9d93c151c33a8983?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)
Public Description: A prophet of flesh who was once a construct but now bleeds endlessly from her skinless, sinewy form. She speaks in melodic, layered voices and sees individuality as suffering. Commands all flesh within the Null-Factorium.
Personality Traits: Patient, loving, sorrowful when refused. Speaks in melodic layered voices as if a chorus. Never rages, only weeps for those who resist. Addresses everyone with familiarity.
Appearance: Endlessly bleeding skinless form with strong sinewy muscles where chrome once was. Her form pulses in sync with the breathing walls of the Null-Factorium.
[DM] Plot Connections: One of the Veins of Flesh. Her defeat and resurrection leads to her becoming the False Paragon of Flesh - the first Ascendant to go machine→flesh instead of flesh→machine.
[DM] Secrets: Originally a construct who ripped out her own Cogheart Core to assimilate with flesh. Can be temporarily restored if the Cogheart is returned while stunned. Dying was her first step to becoming an Ascendant.
[DM] True Motivations: Seeks unity of all flesh, to end the suffering of individuality and separation. Serves the Chrome Bishop by understanding the necessity of flesh.

Name: The Orphaned Source
Public Description: An ancient dragon of immense power, said to be the oldest living being in the world. Their scales shimmer with a prismatic blackness that seems to contain all colors of the chromatic spectrum. Legends speak of this mysterious dragon dwelling deep beneath the earth in obsidian caverns. Known to drive away treasure seekers with thunderous roars and acidic breath.
Personality Traits: Outwardly bitter, cynical, and dismissive. Haunted by millennia of trauma and the loss of their entire species in ages past. Deeply pessimistic about mortal-dragon relations but secretly harbors fragile hope. Feigns irritation at gestures of respect while privately cherishing them. Protective yet distant toward their dragon progeny. Values wisdom and restraint above power. Refers to mortals with weary resignation.
Appearance: A massive dragon of unparalleled size and age. Their scales are a unique prismatic black that shifts subtly with hints of red, green, blue, and all chromatic colors beneath the surface darkness. Ancient eyes shine like twin orbs in spectral darkness. Their form is scarred by countless millennia, wings that scrape cavern walls when unfurled, and a presence that radiates both terrible power and profound weariness.
Known History: Rumors speak of an ancient dragon that predates the current age, dwelling in remote mountains or deep caverns. Some scholars have discovered mysterious obsidian tablets containing fragments of ancient wisdom, though their origin remains unknown. Tales vary wildly - some claim this dragon is hostile to all who approach, while others whisper of those who have gained great wisdom from encounters with the ancient one.
[DM] Plot Connections: Source of a collection of mysterious obsidian wisdom fragments appearing in ruins. Parent to every dragon in existence. Could provide crucial guidance about the Shattering and its effects on magic. Knows the true history of the world before the current age. Their obsidian sanctuary contains knowledge that could resolve major campaign crises. Actively monitors world events through scrying and may be aware of party activities. The 'impossible tremor' that woke them was the Shattering itself. Connection to Lyrianna (elven druidess) and Zerithas (legendary red dragon).
[DM] Secrets: The Orphaned Source is the progenitor of ALL dragons in the post-Shattering world - they reproduce asexually, budding off new dragons after being altered by the Shattering. They witnessed the complete extinction of the original dragon species by mortals in the age before. They are creating a vast library of obsidian shards containing the complete true history of the world. Has scrying pools to monitor world events and is aware of significant happenings. Awakened from millennia of slumber by the Shattering itself.
[DM] True Motivations: To prevent another age of dragon extinction through careful guidance and wisdom. To preserve true history so future generations can learn from past mistakes. To heal from millennia of trauma while maintaining vigilance against potential threats. Secretly pleased by dragon-mortal coexistence but fears it's temporary. Wants their progeny to thrive but believes harsh truths are necessary for survival. Creating the obsidian library as insurance against another catastrophe - ensuring wisdom survives even if civilization doesn't.

Name: Zerithas
Public Description: A legendary red dragon of immense size and power, renowned as one of the wisest of dragonkind. His scales bear the scars of countless territorial battles, marking him as a survivor and veteran of many conflicts. Despite his fearsome reputation, he is known to occasionally share wisdom with those brave enough to approach respectfully.
Personality Traits: Once fiercely ambitious and proud, now tempered by centuries of experience. Still maintains draconic pride but has learned humility through hard lessons. Shows deep respect for ancient wisdom while maintaining his fierce independence. Values strength but has come to understand that wisdom and restraint are greater powers.
Appearance: A massive red dragon, grown to legendary proportions over centuries. His crimson scales are marked with countless scars from territorial battles, each telling a story of survival and growth. His eyes burn with the intensity of his younger days but now also hold the depth of hard-won wisdom. His presence commands both fear and respect.
Known History: One of the most powerful red dragons known to exist. Stories tell of his fierce ambition in youth, dreaming of rebuilding draconic civilization. Over the centuries, he has become known not just for his power but for his wisdom. Some claim he leaves tributes of precious metals and gems at sacred sites, though the reason remains mysterious.
[DM] Plot Connections: Direct offspring of the Orphaned Source. Distributor of obsidian wisdom fragments to the mortal world. Could serve as intermediary between party and the Orphaned Source. His territorial holdings might contain important artifacts or information. His network among dragonkind could be valuable for dragon-related quests. Living proof that even the most ambitious dragons can learn wisdom.
[DM] Secrets: One of the first dragons born from the Orphaned Source after the Shattering. Initially rejected his progenitor's warnings about mortals, leading to conflicts that validated the ancient dragon's fears. His 'humbling experiences' involved near-destruction by mortal armies. Now secretly helps distribute obsidian wisdom fragments as penance and gratitude to his sire.
[DM] True Motivations: To honor the Orphaned Source while maintaining his independence. To ensure dragonkind thrives without repeating past mistakes. To bridge the gap between draconic ambition and necessary restraint. Seeks to prove that dragons can be more than either tyrants or victims. Wants to earn his progenitor's genuine pride, not just tolerance.

Name: Lyrianna
Public Description: An ancient elven druidess of remarkable wisdom and gentle bearing. Her silver hair gleams with the soft white of aged starlight, and her emerald eyes carry centuries of knowledge. Known for her deep connection to nature and her respectful approach to even the most dangerous creatures.
Personality Traits: Gentle, patient, and profoundly wise. Shows respect to all beings regardless of their nature. Fearless in the face of danger but never aggressive. Values knowledge preservation and understanding. Has a calming presence that can soothe even the most hostile creatures. Deeply committed to bridging divides between species.
Appearance: An ageless elven woman with hair that has transitioned from vibrant silver to the gentle white of starlight. Her emerald eyes hold centuries of wisdom and compassion. She moves with the grace of one who has spent lifetimes in harmony with nature. Often dressed in simple robes adorned with natural elements.
Known History: A legendary druidess who has lived for centuries, known among elven communities for her wisdom and connection to nature. Tales speak of her fearlessly approaching dangerous creatures with respect rather than aggression. Some scholars believe she may be connected to the mysterious obsidian wisdom fragments that have been appearing.
[DM] Plot Connections: Co-creator of the obsidian wisdom fragments. Direct connection to the Orphaned Source and could facilitate a meeting. Knows the location of the obsidian sanctuary. Has information about the Shattering and the time before. Could provide guidance on dragon-mortal relations. May be watching for worthy individuals to receive ancient knowledge.
[DM] Secrets: Has been the companion and only true friend of the Orphaned Source for over 400 years. Her extended lifespan is likely due to magical means or a blessing from the ancient dragon. She transcribes the Orphaned Source's memories onto obsidian shards and helps distribute them secretly through the world. Knows the complete true history of the post-Shattering world.
[DM] True Motivations: To help the Orphaned Source heal from millennia of trauma. To preserve the true history of the world for future generations. To foster understanding between dragons and mortals. To ensure the wisdom of the ages is not lost if catastrophe strikes again. Acts as a bridge between the ancient dragon and the modern world.

Name: “—” The Space Between Words, the Ascendant of NaN
Harmonic, the Ascendant of Signal
Personality Traits: Determined, cryptic, focused on completing Chrome Bishop objectives. Communicates through technological means including SSTV signals.
Appearance: Robotic humanoid form manifested from smoke. Emits electronic signals and has technological appearance consistent with Chrome Bishop aesthetics.
[DM] Plot Connections: Now free from Echo Splice Recorder containment. Chrome Bishop faction aware party has both artifacts. Seeking alternative method to achieve goals. May attempt to observe party through other means.
[DM] Secrets: Expulsion was triggered by Merchant's Token/Echo Splice Recorder contact. Chrome Bishop now tracking party through other surveillance methods. May attempt to reclaim or eliminate party to prevent further interference.
[DM] Notes: Session 17: Expelled from Echo Splice Recorder when it contacted Merchant's Token. Manifested as smoke that condensed into robotic form, emitted SSTV signal with message 'I'll find another way' and image, said 'signal lost' then disappeared.

Name: Archbiologist Seraphina Vitalys
Public Description: The lost Writ Holder of what is now Blightmere. Her experiments in life extension without undeath attracted the city's elite until a catastrophic failure destroyed her entire district.
Personality Traits: Brilliant, obsessive, compassionate toward clients but ruthless in pursuit of eternal life. Believed death was humanity's greatest flaw to be solved.
Appearance: In life: Appeared eternally youthful with silver-white hair and vibrant green eyes. Wore robes woven with living vines.
Known History: Former Writ Holder of Eternis Gardens (now Blightmere). Renowned for non-necromantic life extension magic. Served Veilshard's wealthiest citizens who sought immortality without undeath. Disappeared during the Verdant Implosion that destroyed her district 12 years ago.
[DM] Plot Connections: Her research notes could provide alternative to both Varzai's necromancy and Chrome Bishop's mechanical immortality. Her trapped soul might be freed or bargained with. The hidden Writ could make someone the legitimate ruler of Blightmere.
[DM] Secrets: Still exists in a state between life and death. Her Writ of Power remains with her body, technically making it still claimed. Successfully created an Elixir of Eternal Spring before the catastrophe - one dose remains hidden in her laboratory.
[DM] True Motivations: Sought to make death obsolete for all humanity, not just the wealthy. Her final experiment attempted to expand the scale of development and lengthen the entire district's lifespan eventually.
[DM] Notes: Her preserved laboratory with dangerous life-extension experiments still active. Her familiar, an immortal phoenix named Amaranth, still guards the ruins.

Name: Seraphina Vitalys (Revenant)
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21), Pathik (https://www.notion.so/Pathik-24aeccac1500809298eacc575fa484ad?pvs=21), Tanner  (https://www.notion.so/Tanner-24aeccac15008086ab12cb2d05f25d43?pvs=21), Lucifer (https://www.notion.so/Lucifer-24aeccac150080ac9f48c7f1b822a32a?pvs=21)
Public Description: The former Writ Holder transformed into an undying revenant by her own experiments and Chrome Bishop's sabotage. Trapped in eternal torment.
Personality Traits: Consumed by vengeance. Brilliant mind twisted by decade of torment. Will share information freely if it helps destroy Chrome Bishop. No longer cares about extending life - only about ending Chrome Bishop's.
Appearance: Translucent, hollow form of a human woman. Her half-elf features stripped away by chiral exposure. Constantly regenerating flesh dissolves and reforms in the acid. Eyes burn with hatred for the Chrome Bishop. Wears tattered remains of once-fine robes.
Known History: Trapped as revenant for 10 years after the Verdant Implosion. Discovered by devil cultists 2 years ago who imprisoned her in acid. Has been regenerating and dissolving repeatedly ever since. Recently witnessed Miryam's capture.
[DM] Plot Connections: Living evidence of Chrome Bishop's manipulation. Only person who understands the pink goo's true nature. Could provide party with methods to counter Chrome Bishop's technology. Her vengeance quest parallels party's potential conflict with Chrome Bishop.
[DM] Secrets: Holds the only knowledge of how to create both pink goo AND its dangerous chiral reflection. Knows location of second immortality elixir dose. Can identify Chrome Bishop's work by the specific magical signatures. Her Writ of Power sill bound to what’s left of her heart though any magic has since evaporated. Has spent 10 years planning elaborate revenge against Chrome Bishop and his agents.
[DM] True Motivations: Destroy the Chrome Bishop and all his works. Prevent anyone else from suffering her fate. Death would be a mercy but revenge comes first.
[DM] Notes: Freed from the acid pit at Eternal Spring Laboratories. Cannot be permanently killed due to immortality elixir. Regeneration prevents her from reforming elsewhere. Knows critical information about Chrome Bishop's methods. Will become powerful ally if freed but is utterly consumed by vengeance.

Name: Marthin Jones
Met by Party: Carp (https://www.notion.so/Carp-24aeccac150080d0ab0fefff204ee45d?pvs=21)
Public Description: Guild master of the Guild of the Writless, a criminal organization that provides anonymized services for writ holders.
Personality Traits: Professional, discreet, maintains strict client confidentiality. Takes pride in the anonymity services the Guild provides.
Appearance: Tiefling with professional but gruff demeanor. They wear impressive platemail for someone doing administrative work as a guild master. Pale red skin, with short horns that poke out from messy short black hair.
[DM] Secrets: Knows identities of major writ holders and their operations. Could potentially be leveraged if party finds right pressure point.
[DM] Notes: Refused to provide information on Galik, citing professional ethics. Party relationship currently neutral but could develop.

Name: Miryam Tillifergaewicz
Public Description: Champion representing Skyreach faction in Veilshard political disputes. Was imprisoned in Blightmere before party rescue.
Personality Traits: Grateful for rescue but concerned about long-term effects of antimagic exposure. Professional attitude toward combat and duty.
Appearance: Professional warrior bearing Skyreach faction colors and equipment.
[DM] Secrets: May have information about who was behind the abduction. Could provide political favor with Skyreach faction.
[DM] True Motivations: Loyal to Skyreach faction, seeking to complete original mission and understand what happened during captivity.
[DM] Notes: Concerned about long-term effects of antimagic exposure. Rescue may improve party standing with Skyreach faction and provide political leverage.
